candidates.title: TokenScale: Timely and Accurate Autoscaling for Disaggregated LLM Serving with Token Velocity
candidates.reason: Autoscaling for P/D-disaggregated serving using token velocity as a cross-stage leading indicator and convertible decoders as burst buffers; production-trace evaluation improves SLO attainment to 80-96% and reduces cost 4-14%.

candidates.title: Hierarchical Autoscaling for Large Language Model Serving with Chiron
candidates.reason: Hierarchical-backpressure autoscaler incorporating queue size, utilization and request SLOs for mixed interactive/batch LLM serving; reports up to 90% higher SLO attainment and 70% better GPU efficiency.
